plan.question: Does 16->8MiB improve Fork elapsed/RSS without unacceptable SQL cost?
plan.experimental_delta: Same binary, validated argv[11]/argv[12] strings 16M->8M before mysql_server_init. No change to algorithm, compiled guest identity is origin only; experimental overlay hashes separate. Both arms execute full argv validation.
plan.order: 16/8 on even pairs, 8/16 on odd; rotate fixture/mode cells
plan.rss: same-process 0/1/4 held; GC + FreeOSMemory +100ms before every point
plan.exit: fixed 5 pairs; retain all outliers; candidate / retain16 / specific missing-input hold; no automatic sweep or resampling. Single-Mac experiment only; canonical guest rebuild and both-OS acceptance are separate.
